After applying: Watch for follow-up requests

  1. Check your eligibility

    Go back

  2. Submit your application

    Go back
  3. 3

    Complete follow-up requests

    It's common for your state's agency to contact you for additional information or to schedule a quick interview. This doesn't mean you've done anything wrong.

    Save your confirmation

    Save your confirmation number or take a screenshot as proof you applied.

    Check for messages and follow-ups

    Check your email, mail, and voicemail — a text or call from an unknown number is often the state.

    Respond by the deadline Important

    If your agency requests an interview or documents, respond by the deadline to avoid delays.

    Tip: Save your agency's number as a contact on your phone so you don't miss messages.
